# Apt packages for the Tidy Changed (clang-tidy) job in lint-and-format.yml.
# One package per line; comments starting with # are ignored.

# gcc from ubuntu-toolchain-r/test: the ubuntu-24.04 image's newest gcc is 14,
# and the tree targets C23 / C++26 (ADR-0692). gcc supplies the system headers
# clang-tidy parses, so the ratchet's warning counts depend on it (ADR-1230).
gcc-15
g++-15
ninja-build
nasm
jq
parallel

# clang-tidy-22 from apt.llvm.org: the ubuntu-24.04 image tops out at clang 18,
# whose libstdc++ has no std::expected (ADR-0692).
clang-tidy-22
